Tom Pearl

Husband & Friend

I made this page for my friend Tom. Tom is not a complicated guy, and I wanted a spot on the internet where you can get a little closer to the real him.

Tom made some videos online. He didn’t do it for attention. He did it to bring in money to help pay for his wife’s surgery. That is the whole reason. He would do just about anything for her.

Tom’s health is not great, either. He has two heart machines that keep him alive, every hour of every day. That is a lot to carry around, and he carries it without much complaining.

All Tom asks for is peace and quiet. That’s it. No more, no less.

Tom’s Video

If you’ve seen Tom around, please be kind. A little peace and quiet goes a long way for a man with two heart machines and a wife to look after. Thank you for stopping by.
